🚨 BRAKING 🚨 

Joel Biden has announced that he is impeaching (Latin for “withdrawing”) himself from the Presidential race. So how do the dominoes fall from here?

1. Hunter Biden is next in the line of secession and will assume the presidency

2. As a convicted felon, however, Hunter is ineligible to run for president, so the Democrats can’t run him

3. The constitution dictates that the primary winner be the nominee, so with Biden out, the nomination goes to JFK’s son, @RobertKennedyJr, who finished second 

4. You may be saying “well isn’t Trump also ineligible due to the no felonies rule?” No, Trump can run because the Supreme Court overturned his conviction and found that he has absolute diplomatic immunity 

If these facts make you uncomfortable, that’s a you problem, not a me problem
